The school needs 6 maths teachers, 5 physics teachers and 5 chemistry teachers, meaning 6 distinct people qualified in maths. A single teacher counts as one maths teacher no matter how many maths "slots" they could fill, so the submitted assignment of "4 maths" to T1 is invalid. Only three subjects exist, so the "maximum 4" limit never binds; each teacher can cover at most the 3 subjects once each. The maths requirement alone forces at least 6 teachers. Six suffice: all 6 teach maths, 5 of them also teach physics, and 5 also teach chemistry. The minimum is 6.

The submitted answer of 4 is wrong. The response even noted the 6 reading but dismissed it because it makes "maximum 4" irrelevant. That does not change the correct answer.
